text:
maria: FYI — canary sensors for streaming-embeddings in us-central are showing steadily increasing p95 latency over the last 18h. Not huge (40ms -> 230ms) but it's correlated with higher GPU allocation churn and some pod restarts. 

maria: I think our blackbox probes are amplifying load during rebalancing windows. We should avoid storming the fleet when nodes churn.

sre-bot: alert triggered: canary_stream_p95_us_central > 200ms (6/5m) — runbook id: infra/canary-stream/2

tj: Can you paste the prometheus query? I want to see the shape and if it's an aggregate artifact.

maria: PromQL I used is below — pulling p95 across the canary set:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(canary_stream_response_duration_seconds_bucket{region="us-central"}[5m])) by (le, probe_id))
```

kevin: Two quick thoughts: 1) Decrease probe frequency for streaming probes during maintenance windows. 2) Add a short cooldown jitter when we detect node lifecycle events so probes don't align.

anna: +1. Also we have a cheap optimization: switch longer-running streaming checks to sample mode (1/10) and keep a small subset in continuous mode. Saves ~30-40% tokens and GPU-side KV pressure.

maria: Agreed. Would like to land an auto-sample mode in the playbook. Proposal: when cluster autoscaler activity > 0 for a zone in last 10m, flip sampling to 0.1 for that zone for 30m.

devex-liz: We should also update the Grafana SLO dashboard to show probe sampling rate and token cost per probe. Right now SLO panels hide probe cost.

tj: For alerts, let's change the canary alert to require sustained p95 > 200ms for 10m and only for >50% of probes in zone. That will cut false positives from single-node flaps.

kevin: Agreed. I can draft the alert rule. Proposed boolean expression (pseudo):
```
count_over_time((canary_p95_us_central > 0.2)[10m:1m]) / count_over_time(canary_probe_up[10m:1m]) > 0.5
```

maria: Nice. Also adding a tagging field on probe runs for 'sampled' vs 'continuous' would let us break down cost in the console.

anna: For the playbook step-by-step:
- Detect autoscaler events via metric nodepool_scaler_events_total > 0
- Trigger probe-sampler lambda to flip sampling config per zone
- Add cooldown with exponential backoff if nodes keep churning
- Emit audit event to ops channel

maria: Can someone own the PR and a short test? I can take the Grafana panel work.

kevin: I'll own the alert change and unit tests for the promql.

tj: I'll write the sampler lambda and add a dry-run flag. Will post a draft by EOD.

devex-liz: I'll add a cost-widget mock and a small note to the docs so customers understand why probes might be sampled during churn.

sre-bot: next steps recorded: owner=kevin(alerts), owner=tj(sampler), owner=maria(grafana), owner=devex-liz(docs) — ETA 48h for first patch.

maria: Thanks — priority medium. We don't want probes to be the reason we overshoot GPU budgets during noisy resizes. :money_with_wings:

tj: one more: I'll make sure websocket handshake retries are capped at 2 during sampling so we don't amplify ephemeral network blips.

kevin: Great. If we still see residual noise after these measures, we can look at out-of-band lightweight status endpoints (no KV warmup) for canaries.

maria: Perfect. Closing loop once PRs are up. :white_check_mark:
